inspections.name: Pre-start document pack
checklist: Signed contract, priced BOQ, programme and stamped For-Construction drawing set all on file
Building Permit issued in the Building Customer's name (Cl.1.2); utility NOCs obtained
Construction All Risks and Public Liability insurance valid for the full contract period (Cl.9.1)
Key personnel named with CVs: project manager, site engineer, safety officer (Cl.10.1d)
HSE plan issued and compliant with Thai health and safety law (Cl.10.1e)
Subcontractor list submitted; no unapproved subcontractor engaged (Cl.4.4)

inspections.name: Boundary, benchmark & pre-existing condition survey
checklist: Boundary pegs agree with Title Deed 28276 / Land No. 35 and the surveyor's plan
Permanent benchmark established, referenced and physically protected
Access lane photographed in its pre-existing condition before any plant enters
Neighbouring property and boundary walls photographed for the record
Setback distances comply with the Building Permit

inspections.name: Site establishment & temporary services
checklist: Site fenced, gated and lockable; safety signage displayed
Site office, welfare and sanitation provided
Material store covered, dry and off the ground
Temporary power installed with RCD protection and correct earthing
Temporary water adequate for concrete curing

inspections.name: Setting out check against approved site plan
checklist: Building position and orientation agree with the approved site plan within ±25 mm
Finished floor level set and referenced to the permanent benchmark
Setback distances comply with the Building Permit
Diagonals checked; the setting-out is square
Profiles and pegs secure and clearly marked

inspections.name: Excavation to formation — bearing stratum
inspections.tests: Visual stratum ID; DCP if specified
checklist: Only vegetation within the approved footprint removed; retained trees protected
Topsoil stripped and stockpiled separately, inside the boundary
Excavation depth and levels agree with the structural drawing
Formation firm and undisturbed — no soft spots, roots or organic material
Excavation dewatered; no standing water at formation
Sides battered or supported; no risk of collapse
Structural Engineer has confirmed the bearing stratum IN WRITING

inspections.name: Engineered fill placement & compaction test
checklist: Fill material approved and free of organic or oversized matter
Placed in layers not exceeding 200 mm
Compaction test carried out per layer by an accredited laboratory
Result achieves the specified percentage of maximum dry density
Test certificate on file for every layer — not a verbal assurance

inspections.name: Earthworks completion, drainage & erosion control
checklist: Formation levels across the whole footprint surveyed and within tolerance
Surface water diverted away from all excavations
Silt and erosion control in place ahead of the monsoon
Survey record signed by both parties
Site safe and stable for the next phase

inspections.name: Footing setting out, excavation & blinding
checklist: Footing positions, sizes and founding levels agree with the structural drawing
Excavation clean, trimmed and dewatered
Blinding placed to the specified thickness and level
Working surface firm and clean — no mud contamination of the reinforcement zone

inspections.name: Footing rebar & formwork — PRE-POUR HOLD, then pour & cube test
checklist: PART A — Bar size, number, spacing and lap lengths match the bending schedule
PART A — Cover maintained on every face by proper spacers (not stones or broken block)
PART A — Steel clean, securely tied; cage does not move underfoot
PART A — Starter bars for the next lift correctly positioned and of adequate length
PART A — Formwork rigid, grout-tight, aligned and braced; release agent not on the steel
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Delivery ticket grade correct; slump tested and within tolerance
PART B — Minimum one cube set taken, labelled and correctly cured
PART B — Fully compacted by poker; no segregation; curing started immediately
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above the specified grade (close this item when received)

inspections.name: Retaining wall rebar & formwork — PRE-POUR HOLD, then pour & cube test
checklist: PART A — Vertical and horizontal steel, starter bars and cover match the design
PART A — Waterstops continuous and correctly positioned at construction joints
PART A — Formwork plumb, tied and propped for the design pour pressure
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Placed in controlled lifts; no cold joints; fully compacted at the wall base
PART B — Slump tested; cube set taken; cured wet for the specified period
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade (close this item when received)

inspections.name: Retaining wall drainage, weepholes & tanking — CRITICAL HIDDEN
checklist: Tanking membrane continuous on the retained face — no punctures, blisters or pinholes
Membrane lapped and dressed at every termination; protection board fitted
Free-draining granular drainage layer, full height
Geotextile filter wrapping the drainage layer to prevent silting
Perforated land drain at the base, laid to fall, with a positive outlet
Weepholes clear and functioning under a water test
EVERY METRE photographed with a tape in shot before anything is placed against it

inspections.name: Backfill to retaining wall & compaction
checklist: Concrete has reached the specified strength before any backfill
Free-draining granular backfill used
Placed in controlled layers and compacted
No damage to the membrane, protection board or drain during placing
Wall verticality re-checked after backfill

inspections.name: Below-slab services 1st fix — drainage, sanitary & electrical conduit
checklist: Pipe sizes, routes and invert levels agree with the sanitary layout
Falls correct to every run and proven by survey — not by eye
Water or air tightness test passed and certified
Rodding access provided at every change of direction
Electrical conduit routes, depths and draw boxes agree with the electrical layout
Draw wires installed and continuous
Every run photographed and dimensioned from a fixed reference before covering

inspections.name: Anti-termite treatment, DPM & sand blinding pre-slab
checklist: Termite treatment applied and certificate on file
Damp-proof membrane continuous, lapped 300 mm minimum
Sealed at every penetration and turned up at all edges
No tears, punctures or unsealed laps
Sand blinding protects the membrane from the reinforcement above

inspections.name: Lower ground columns & walls — rebar, formwork, pour & cube test
checklist: PART A — Steel matches the schedule; cover maintained; starter bars set for the floor above
PART A — Formwork and propping designed for the load, on a firm base, plumb and braced
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Correct grade, slump tested, cube set taken
PART B — Fully compacted; no honeycombing at bases after striking
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade

inspections.name: Ground slab rebar, cover & cast-in items — PRE-POUR HOLD, then pour
checklist: PART A — Mesh or bar correct, laps adequate, spacers in place, no displacement
PART A — All conduits, sleeves, drainage penetrations and holding-down bolts fixed
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Correct grade; slump tested; cube set taken
PART B — Surface level and flatness within tolerance; curing started immediately
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade

inspections.name: Pool excavation & setting out against pool detail
checklist: Pool position, dimensions and depths agree with the pool drawing
Floor profile and step positions correct
Excavation stable and dewatered
Clearance to the retaining wall and its drainage confirmed

inspections.name: Pool shell rebar, waterstops & sleeves — PRE-POUR HOLD, then pour
checklist: PART A — Reinforcement continuous through the floor-to-wall junction
PART A — Waterstops continuous and correctly jointed
PART A — Inlet, return, skimmer, main drain and light sleeves cast in the correct positions
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Placed continuously to avoid cold joints
PART B — Fully compacted, especially at wall bases and around sleeves
PART B — Cured wet for the specified period

inspections.name: Pool structural water-tightness test — 48 hour
checklist: Pool filled and starting level marked and photographed with the time visible
Level after 48 hours photographed with the time visible
Drop within the allowable limit after evaporation correction
No visible seepage anywhere on the external face
Test record signed by both parties — GATE G1.3 cannot pass without this

inspections.name: 1st floor columns — rebar, formwork, pour & cube test
checklist: PART A — Main bars, links, lap positions and cover correct; columns plumb
PART A — Starter bars for the floor above correctly projected
PART A — Formwork rigid, plumb, grout-tight and braced
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Correct grade; slump tested; cube set taken; no segregation
PART B — No honeycombing at column bases after striking
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade

inspections.name: 1st floor beam & slab — formwork, rebar, cast-in MEP, pour & cube
checklist: PART A — Soffit level and camber as designed; props on firm bearing, correct spacing, braced
PART A — Top and bottom steel correct and in the right position; chairs maintaining cover
PART A — Openings trimmed; all cast-in conduits, sleeves and penetrations fixed
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Continuous pour; correct grade; slump tested; cube set taken
PART B — Finished to level and flatness tolerance; cured wet
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade

inspections.name: Staircase — rebar, formwork, pour & dimensional verification
checklist: Rise and going equal throughout the flight and matching the architectural drawing
Reinforcement and landing connections correct
WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
Every riser measured after striking and within 5 mm of every other riser
Headroom compliant; no trip hazard from uneven risers

inspections.name: Formwork striking & concrete surface defect inspection
checklist: Formwork struck only after the required strength or period was achieved
Backpropping retained where required
Surface free of honeycombing, exposed steel or significant defects
Any defect raised as an NCR with an Engineer-approved repair method before the gate passes

inspections.name: 2nd floor columns — rebar, formwork, pour & cube test
checklist: PART A — Main bars, links, laps and cover correct; columns plumb
PART A — Starter bars for the roof level correctly projected
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Correct grade; slump tested; cube set taken; fully compacted
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade

inspections.name: 2nd floor beam & slab — formwork, rebar, cast-in MEP, pour & cube
checklist: PART A — Soffit levels within tolerance; backpropping from the floor below retained
PART A — Top and bottom steel correct; cover maintained; openings trimmed
PART A — All cast-in MEP items fixed before pour
PART A — WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
PART B — Correct grade; slump tested; cube set taken; finished and cured
PART B — 28-day cube result at or above grade

inspections.name: Frame completion survey — verticality, level & dimension
checklist: Overall building verticality surveyed and within tolerance
Floor levels surveyed at every level
Room dimensions checked against the architectural plans
Deviations recorded and accepted IN WRITING before architectural works begin
This is the last chance to correct geometry cheaply

inspections.name: Roof RC works & falls survey — rebar, pour and geometry
inspections.tests: Cover check; slump; cubes; falls survey
checklist: Roof slab and beam steel, falls and upstands as designed
WRITTEN RELEASE ISSUED before concrete is ordered
Correct grade concrete, compacted and cured
Falls achieved to every outlet — no ponding areas under a water test
Geometry correct for the roof covering

inspections.name: Structural steel — certificates, fabrication & welding
inspections.tests: Certificate review; visual weld; NDT if specified
checklist: Mill certificates provided for every section
Grade and section size match the structural drawing — no substitution (Cl.4.2)
Welds continuous and correctly sized; no undercut, porosity or excessive spatter
Welder qualification evidenced
Fabrication dimensions within tolerance

inspections.name: Steel erection, bolt torque & corrosion protection
inspections.tests: Torque check; level survey; DFT gauge
checklist: Members erected to line, level and plumb
Baseplates fully bedded and grouted
All bolts present, correct grade and torqued
Temporary bracing retained until permanent stability is achieved
Primer and finish coats at the specified dry film thickness, verified by gauge
Site welds and damaged coating made good — critical in an island environment

inspections.name: Roof underlay, membrane & flashings — HIDDEN
checklist: Structure released before any covering is laid
Underlay or membrane continuous, correctly lapped and mechanically fixed
Dressed into gutters and up all abutments to the required height
Flashings, valleys, ridge and hip details complete
Penetration collar fitted to every pipe, vent and fixing
EVERY roof plane photographed before covering

inspections.name: Roof covering installation & water tightness test
inspections.tests: Hose/spray test min. 30 min per plane
checklist: Covering matches the approved product and finishing schedule
Correctly lapped, aligned and mechanically fixed against wind uplift
Ridge, hip and verge details complete
Water test on EVERY roof plane, valley and penetration for at least 30 minutes
No leakage, damp patch or drip observed internally — record signed

inspections.name: Gutters, downpipes & connection to underground drainage
checklist: Gutters to correct falls, securely fixed, no ponding
Downpipes connected to the underground system — all piping underground (Cl.11.3)
Flow test passed with no leaks at any joint
Outlets and gullies clear

inspections.name: Wall setting out — room dimension verification
checklist: Masonry material matches the approved sample; units sound and stored dry
EVERY room set out and its internal dimensions checked against the plan BEFORE building
Diagonals checked for square in every room
Door and window opening positions marked
This is the cheapest error to fix now and the most expensive later

inspections.name: Brickwork — coursing, verticality, ties, lintels & bond
checklist: Walls plumb and level within tolerance
Coursing consistent; joints full and of even thickness
Wall ties and starter bars at the specified centres
Lintels correctly sized with adequate bearing over every opening
Movement joints where designed
Chases cut not hacked; no horizontal chasing in loadbearing walls

inspections.name: Structural openings — dimensional check vs D&W schedule
checklist: EVERY structural opening measured and recorded
Each measurement compared against the door and window schedule
Deviations resolved in writing BEFORE the owner-supplied units are ordered
Measurements photographed with a tape in shot
Schedule signed off as buildable

inspections.name: Substrate prep, mesh & service chase reinstatement
checklist: ALL MEP first fix inspected, tested and released before covering
Substrate clean, dampened and keyed
Reinforcing mesh over every chase and at every junction of dissimilar materials
Angle beads installed at all arrises

inspections.name: Plaster & render — internal and external
checklist: Applied in the specified number of coats and thickness
Deviation under a 2 m straightedge within tolerance
Walls plumb; internal and external angles true and square
No hollowness when tapped
Drip grooves formed under all external projections; sills laid to fall
No shrinkage or map cracking after curing

inspections.name: Wet area waterproofing application — CRITICAL HIDDEN
checklist: Substrate clean, sound and dry; fillets formed at all internal angles
Specified number of coats at the specified thickness
Reinforcing tape at every junction, corner and penetration
Membrane turned up walls to the required height — verify this, it is the commonest cut corner
All penetrations sealed with proprietary collars
EVERY bathroom photographed in full before tiling

inspections.name: Wet area flood test — 24 hour, every area individually
checklist: Each wet area flooded individually — no sampling, no exceptions
Start level and time photographed
Level after 24 hours photographed with the time visible
No drop in level and no dampness on the underside or in adjacent rooms
Signed record for EVERY wet area — GATE G2.2 cannot pass without this

inspections.name: Ceiling framing, hangers, levels & void services — HIDDEN
checklist: ALL services above the ceiling installed, tested and RELEASED before boarding
Framing and hangers at specified centres, fixed to structure not to services
Ceiling level consistent across and between rooms
Access route left to every valve, damper and junction box
The FULL ceiling void photographed before boarding

inspections.name: Ceiling boarding, access panels & fixture cut-outs
checklist: Boards fixed at correct centres, joints staggered and taped
Access panel at every valve, damper and junction box
Light and grille cut-outs set out to the reflected ceiling plan
Perimeter shadow gaps or trims consistent
No visible fastener heads after finishing

inspections.name: Paint — sample panel approval & application quality
checklist: Brand, type and colour match the approved finishing schedule; sealed tins only
Sample panel of each colour approved and SIGNED by the Owner before full application
Surfaces filled, sanded, dusted and sealed
Specified number of coats applied
Even opacity under raking light — no roller marks, runs, sags or misses
Clean cut-in lines; adjacent surfaces unmarked; touch-up paint left labelled by room

inspections.name: Staircase finishes — treads, risers, nosings & balustrade
checklist: Finished rise and going equal throughout the flight
Nosings secure and slip-resistant
Balustrade at the required height with compliant gaps
Balustrade rigid under a horizontal load test
Finish matches the approved schedule

inspections.name: Owner-supplied floor material — verification, shade & batch
checklist: Delivered tile matches the approved sample
ALL boxes from the same batch and shade code — check before laying, not after
Quantity sufficient including wastage, plus 2% attic stock retained
Breakages recorded and photographed on delivery BEFORE acceptance
Stored flat, dry and protected

inspections.name: Screed levels, falls to drains & substrate soundness — HIDDEN
checklist: Screed sound with no hollowness when tapped
Falls to every floor drain proven by water test — no ponding
Levels correct so finished floor levels align across thresholds
Movement joints carried through from the substrate

inspections.name: Tile setting-out, dry lay, installation & grouting
inspections.tests: Tap test; lippage gauge; adhesive lift test
checklist: Setting out and dry lay approved by the Owner before fixing
No sliver cuts at prominent edges; joints align across rooms and thresholds
Solid bed adhesive at specified coverage — verified by lifting a test tile
No hollow-sounding tiles; lippage within tolerance
Grout full, uniform in colour and cleaned off
Movement joints at perimeters and specified centres; silicone neat and continuous

inspections.name: Owner-supplied door & window units — delivery inspection
checklist: Every unit checked against the schedule: size, type, glazing spec, finish, hardware
Damage recorded and photographed on arrival BEFORE acceptance
Quantities complete; ironmongery and fixings present
Stored upright, protected and off the ground

inspections.name: Opening preparation, DPC & frame fixing — HIDDEN
checklist: Damp-proof course and cavity closers installed
Frames fixed with specified anchors at correct centres into SOUND SUBSTRATE — not into plaster
Frames plumb and level with consistent gaps all round
Fixings photographed before sealing

inspections.name: D&W installation, operation & water spray test
inspections.tests: Operation test each unit; water spray test
checklist: Every door and window opens, closes, locks and stays put smoothly without forcing
Ironmongery complete, aligned and correctly handed
Perimeter sealed internally and externally with backer rod and sealant
Sustained water spray on EVERY external opening produces no ingress
Protective film removed at the right time; glass unscratched

inspections.name: Conduit, back-boxes & cable roughing-in — HIDDEN
checklist: Materials TIS certified and matching the specification — no substitution (Cl.4.2)
Conduit run only in permitted zones; not crossing or notching structural steel
Back boxes at correct height, level and flush to the finished plaster line
Correct cable size for every circuit; no joints in concealed runs
Cables undamaged, not over-bent, identified at both ends against the circuit schedule
All routes photographed and dimensioned for the as-built record

inspections.name: Earthing & bonding installation and resistance test — HIDDEN
checklist: Earth electrode installed with an accessible inspection pit
Measured earth resistance within the specified limit — certificate on file
Main bonding to incoming water pipework
Supplementary bonding to the pool, its reinforcement and all metalwork
Life-safety critical — do not release on assurance alone

inspections.name: Water supply pipe roughing-in & pressure test — HIDDEN
checklist: Pipe material, size and routes as drawn; correctly supported and sleeved through structure
Isolation valve to every fixture, accessible
Hot and cold routed to avoid heat transfer; hot pipework insulated
System holds test pressure for at least 2 hours with no measurable drop
Gauge photographed at start AND end with the time visible
Routes photographed and dimensioned before covering

inspections.name: Pre-plaster combined services release — MASTER HOLD POINT
checklist: Every electrical first-fix item inspected, tested and photographed
Every water and drainage item inspected, tested and photographed
Every AC pipework item inspected, tested and photographed
All test certificates on file
SINGLE COMBINED WRITTEN RELEASE issued — no wall, ceiling or slab is closed without it
Covering without this release is an automatic NCR at the Contractor's cost

inspections.name: Soil, waste & vent installation and tightness test — HIDDEN
inspections.tests: Air or water test; fall gradient survey
checklist: Correct pipe sizes and gradients to every fixture, proven by survey
Vents installed to prevent trap siphonage
Rodding access at every change of direction
Adequately supported and sleeved through structure
Air or water test passed and certified for every section before covering

inspections.name: Hot water system & pipework insulation
checklist: Heater installed with a relief valve and safe discharge
Hot pipework insulated throughout
Delivery temperature satisfactory at every outlet
Flow rate adequate at every outlet

inspections.name: Pool plant, pipework pressure test & circulation
checklist: Equipment matches the specification and the pool volume
Plant room drained, ventilated and RCD protected; pipework labelled with flow direction
All suction and return lines hold test pressure with no drop BEFORE backfilling
Gauge photographed at start and end
Turnover period achieved; balanced flow through all inlets
Skimmer and main drain operating; no air entrainment or pump cavitation

inspections.name: Distribution boards & electrical fit-out
checklist: DB accessible; every breaker of correct type and rating for its circuit and cable
RCD or RCBO protection on all required circuits
Clear, permanent, accurate circuit schedule fixed inside the board door
Every socket, switch and luminaire at correct height, level and aligned with adjacent items
Light positions match the reflected ceiling plan
Faceplates undamaged and clean

inspections.name: Electrical test suite & safety certificate
inspections.tests: Insulation; polarity; earth loop; RCD trip time
checklist: Insulation resistance tested on every circuit and within limits
Polarity correct on every circuit
Earth loop impedance within limits
RCD trip times within limits
Signed electrical safety certificate from a licensed electrician (Cl.10.2d)
A failed result blocks GATE G3.3 outright

inspections.name: Sanitaryware installation & water quality test
inspections.tests: Leak & operation test; potable water analysis
checklist: Owner-supplied fixtures checked against the schedule for model, finish and completeness
Damage recorded on arrival before acceptance
Every fixture level, securely fixed and correctly sealed to wall and floor
No leaks under running water; traps correctly installed
Smooth operation of all taps and flush mechanisms
System flushed and disinfected; laboratory water quality certificate on file

inspections.name: AC equipment approval, mounting & concealed pipework — HIDDEN
checklist: Models, capacities and efficiency ratings match the specification and room loads
Pipe sizes and run lengths within the manufacturer's limits
Continuous vapour-sealed insulation — no gaps at joints, bends or supports
Units level and securely mounted on anti-vibration mounts
Outdoor units on stable bases with clearance for airflow and service access
Outdoor unit position considered for noise to bedrooms and neighbours
Concealed routes photographed and dimensioned before covering

inspections.name: Refrigerant pressure & vacuum test
inspections.tests: Nitrogen pressure; vacuum to specified micron
checklist: Nitrogen pressure test held with no drop
Evacuated to the specified vacuum and held
Gauge photographed at start and end of each hold, with the time visible
Charge weight recorded per system

inspections.name: Condensate drainage falls & flow test — EVERY unit
inspections.tests: Water pour flow test on every unit
checklist: Continuous fall to a legal discharge point on every run
Trap fitted where required
Water poured into EVERY drain pan discharges fully with no backup or leak
No unit skipped — this is the commonest cause of ceiling damage in a finished villa

inspections.name: AC commissioning — airflow, temperature split, noise & controls
checklist: Each system achieves the design temperature split
Airflow and noise within limits
Controls, timers and modes function correctly
Commissioning sheet signed per unit (Cl.10.2c)
Warranty registered in the Building Customer's name

inspections.name: Solar PV — structural fixing & roof penetration sealing — HIDDEN
checklist: Mounting rails fixed into structural members, not into battens alone
Fixings rated for the design wind load
EVERY roof penetration sealed with a proprietary flashing
Photographed before panels are placed — roof leaks from PV fixings are the primary risk
Roof water test repeated after fixing

inspections.name: Solar PV — wiring, isolation, earthing & commissioning
checklist: String wiring correct polarity in UV-rated cable
DC isolator accessible and labelled; emergency shutdown labelling in Thai and English
Array earthed and bonded; insulation resistance and earth continuity tested
Measured output matches expected yield for the conditions over 3 days
Inverter configured; monitoring connected and accessible to the Owner

inspections.name: Smart home — cabling, hubs, commissioning & Owner training
checklist: Structured cabling installed, terminated and certified; routes documented before concealment
Hub locations ventilated and accessible with adequate power and network
Every device pairs and responds reliably
Scenes programmed as agreed with the Owner
Owner accounts created and admin credentials handed over
Owner training session completed and signed

inspections.name: Pool waterproofing prior to tiling — CRITICAL HIDDEN
checklist: Membrane applied at the specified thickness over the full shell
Reinforcement at all corners and penetrations
Water test REPEATED after membrane and before tiling
No punctures, blisters or unbonded areas
Entire shell photographed before tiling

inspections.name: Pool tiling, coping levels & 7-day fill test
checklist: Coping SURVEYED level around the full perimeter — do not eyeball it
Tiles solidly bedded, no hollows, joints consistent, grout waterproof
Pool filled, chemistry balanced and stable
All equipment runs 7 days continuously without fault
No measurable water loss beyond evaporation
Lighting and safety features operational

inspections.name: Built-in furniture — material, dimensions, alignment & operation
checklist: Materials match the approved finishing schedule; moisture-resistant substrate in wet areas
Units level, plumb, securely fixed to structure and scribed to walls
Doors and drawers aligned with consistent gaps, soft close where specified
All cut edges sealed against humidity
Internal fittings, shelves and services complete and working

inspections.name: Room-by-room snagging inspection
checklist: Every room inspected systematically against the drawings and finishing schedule
Every external elevation and plant area inspected
Every defect logged with a photograph, location and required action
Each snag categorised honestly: A blocks payment, B rework, C cosmetic
Snag list issued to the Contractor with target dates

inspections.name: Integrated systems commissioning & external works
inspections.tests: Simultaneous load test; surface water flow test
checklist: All systems operated simultaneously under load — electrical, water, drainage, AC, pool, solar, smart home
No breaker trips, no pressure loss, no interference
All commissioning reports collated (Cl.10.2c)
Site graded to drain away from the building; surface water disposal effective under hose test
Driveway, paths, boundary and gates complete and operational
All cables and piping underground (Cl.11.3)

inspections.name: Snag close-out re-inspection
checklist: Every snag verified closed with an AFTER photograph
Nothing closed on the Contractor's word alone
Any item not closed is formally carried forward with a written agreed date
ZERO open Category A snags — GATE G5.2 requires this

inspections.name: Builders clean & final clean
checklist: All construction debris, protective film, paint spots, adhesive and dust removed
Glazing, sanitaryware and floors cleaned
Roof, gutters and drainage clear
Site free of surplus material and temporary works

inspections.name: Handover document pack, utilities & keys
checklist: As-built drawings received: architectural, structural, MEP, landscape and site, showing hidden service routes
O&M manuals and manufacturer warranties for every product, transferred to the Building Customer (Cl.7.4, 11.1)
Certificate pack complete: completion, occupancy, electrical, pressure test, HVAC, water quality, fire (Cl.10.2)
Final BOQ and final account received
Tabien Baan obtained; water and electricity registered in the Building Customer's name (Cl.11.2)
Keys, remotes, fobs and codes listed on a signed inventory and each one tested; construction cylinders changed

inspections.name: Practical Completion inspection & Completion Certificate
checklist: All milestone gates passed
All Category A snags closed and verified
All systems commissioned and witnessed
Full document pack physically in the Owner's hands
Outstanding items carried forward with agreed dates
COMPLETION CERTIFICATE SIGNED — this starts the 30-day retention clock and both warranty periods

inspections.name: Retention release inspection — 30 days after Completion
checklist: No new defect has emerged in the 30-day period
Every previously closed item remains closed
Any new defect notified in writing under Cl.7.3 before release
Only then is the 10% retention (745,673 THB) released per Cl.3.2

inspections.name: Warranty inspection — 6 month and 11 month
checklist: Structural: cracking, settlement, retaining wall movement, pool shell
Watertightness: roof, wet areas, pool water loss, external walls
MEP: electrical, plumbing, hot water, drainage, AC operation and condensate
Finishes: joinery movement, tiling, paint, door and window operation
External: drainage, paving, gates, corrosion of external metalwork
Carry out the 11-month inspection BEFORE the 12-month fittings warranty expires (Cl.7.2)

inspections.name: Structural warranty inspection — 23 month
checklist: Carried out at 23 months, before the 2-year structural warranty expires (Cl.7.1)
Foundations and retaining wall — movement, cracking, drainage function
Frame — cracking, deflection, corrosion staining
Roof structure and steelwork — corrosion, fixings, coating condition
Pool shell — water loss, cracking, tile debonding
Defects notified in writing; Contractor must rectify within 30 days (Cl.7.3)
